info.name: Retell SDK Add Community Voice Get Mcp Tools API

params.name: agent_id
params.description: Unique id of the agent to get MCP tools for.

params.name: version
params.description: Optional version of the agent to use for this request. Default to latest version.

params.name: mcp_id
params.description: The ID of the MCP server to get tools from.

params.name: component_id
params.description: The ID of the component if the MCP server is configured under a component.

items.docs: Get MCP tools for a specific agent
